section_or_heading: 2 Type A evaluation from repeated observations
claim_summary: For independent repeated observations under the stated model, the standard uncertainty of the mean is the sample standard deviation divided by the square root of the observation count.
scope_or_caution: Independence and a stable measurement process are assumptions; other valid statistical methods may be needed.
review_note: Inspected NIST TN 1297 web text on 2026-11-20.

section_or_heading: 3 Type B evaluation from other information
claim_summary: Type B evaluation can use specifications, calibration reports, previous data and other relevant information, interpreted through a probability model.
scope_or_caution: A quoted limit or tolerance is not automatically a standard uncertainty.
review_note: Inspected NIST TN 1297 web text on 2026-11-20.

claim_summary: For a justified rectangular distribution with half-width a, the standard uncertainty is a divided by square root of three.
scope_or_caution: The distribution must be justified by available information; bounded limits alone do not prove rectangularity.
review_note: Inspected NIST TN 1297 web text on 2026-11-20.

claim_summary: For a symmetric triangular distribution with half-width a, the standard uncertainty is a divided by square root of six.
